summary: ENSO-conditional transfer entropy reveals that hemispheric albedo coupling is ENSO-phase-dependent. During La Niña: SH→NH information transfer is significant (TE=0.330, p=0.017, z=2.30) but NH→SH is not. During El Niño: NH→SH is marginally stronger (TE=0.496, p=0.078) but neither direction is significant. During Neutral: SH→NH is marginally dominant. The teleconnection REVERSES direction between phases but is only statistically significant during La Niña. ENSO-albedo correlations: Niño3.4 correlates -0.199 with NH albedo (p=0.0005). This is evidence that ENSO mediates hemispheric albedo teleconnections, with La Niña activating SH→NH information flow.
